label: PF Backlog 218
title: Backend: OCR/document capability pack + doc-parse kind + OCR generators/adapters
body:
## Problem / why
OCR/document understanding is a listed need but has no dedicated kind, pack, or adapters, so scanned/
PDF/table content cannot be ingested reliably across products.

## Goal & value
An `ocr` capability pack with a `ocr/doc-parse` kind, permissive self-host defaults, and paid API
options -- enabled only for projects that need documents.

## In scope
- **Kind** `ocr/doc-parse` + adapter contract (batch: images/PDF in -> text/tables/layout out).
- **Self-host (permissive):** Tesseract (+tessdata), PaddleOCR, RapidOCR, docTR; PDF text via
  pdfplumber/pypdf/pypdfium2.
- **Paid API:** Google Document AI, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, Mistral OCR.
- **Pipeline:** document ingest -> layout/segmentation -> OCR -> structured output -> asset store;
  `doc-analyst` agent gated by the pack.
- **Explicitly excluded** (never bundled): PyMuPDF, poppler, Surya/Marker weights.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- A document-heavy idea enables the ocr pack; a plain app enables none.
- E2E: a scanned PDF -> extracted structured text/tables as an artifact, with per-page confidence.
- Bundled OCR tools are all permissive; restricted libs absent from the package.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: adapter contract with a fixture image; language/resolution selection.
- Integration: sample PDF -> text+table artifact; store-registry + wired_audit green.
